document_summary: August 2026 Morgan Lewis LawFlash (secondary source) on algorithmic rent-pricing litigation and a table of municipal bans on algorithmic rent-setting, including in the in-scope cities of San Francisco, San Diego, Berkeley, Santa Ana, Jersey City and Hoboken.

rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Tenants may sue for damages and injunctive relief.
rules.key_value: Ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
rules.extraction_notes: Secondary source (law firm alert). Effective date from the article's table ('effective October 2024'); exact day not stated. Each month of use per unit may be a separate violation, with civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation.

rules.title: San Diego ban on algorithmic rent-setting (RealPage-type products)
rules.requirement: San Diego prohibits landlords from using algorithmic rent-setting products of the kind at issue in the RealPage litigation, and the ordinance gives tenants a private right to sue.
rules.key_value: Ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices (similar to San Francisco's prohibition)
rules.quoted_span: A San Diego tenant filed _Keller v. UDR Inc._ in the Southern District of California under San Diego Municipal Code § 98.1103, alleging that UDR improperly used RealPage products.
rules.extraction_notes: Secondary source. The article describes the substance only as a 'similar prohibition' to San Francisco's, so the detail of the prohibition is inferred and not stated in full. Effective date is from the table ('effective June 2025'). The quoted span is the complaint description, not the operative text of the ordinance.

rules.title: Berkeley ban on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Berkeley prohibits coordinated rent-pricing algorithms, with private remedies and recurring unit/month violations.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies, previously at issue in _RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley et al._, (N.D. Cal.) (voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026).
rules.conflict_note: Two published effective dates: this August 2026 alert says 'effective January 2026', whereas the ordinance text reportedly says 1 March 2026. The ordinance text is not found in this capture.
rules.extraction_notes: Effective date of 2026-01 is taken from this document's table, which gives only the month. The RealPage challenge was voluntarily dismissed with prejudice on Jan. 14, 2026.

rules.title: Santa Ana Ordinance NS-3090 (automated rent price-fixing)
rules.requirement: Santa Ana prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing, and tenants may bring private claims.
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.extraction_notes: Secondary source. Effective date from the table ('effective April 2, 2026'). Municipal code section not given in the document.

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. The ordinance has both public and private enforcement.
rules.key_value: Ban on landlord use of algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.interaction: Possible preemption by New Jersey's FAIR Act (P.L. 2026, c.43) once effective; not addressed in this document.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.conflict_note: Open question whether the NJ FAIR Act (P.L. 2026, c.43) preempts this ordinance once effective. Not found in this capture.
rules.extraction_notes: Secondary source. Effective date from the table ('effective June 2025'); exact day not stated.

rules.title: Hoboken ban on algorithmic rent coordination
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.key_value: Ban on software/algorithm/data-sharing coordination of rents, lease terms and occupancy
rules.interaction: Possible preemption by New Jersey's FAIR Act (P.L. 2026, c.43) once effective; not addressed in this document.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.conflict_note: Open question whether the NJ FAIR Act (P.L. 2026, c.43) preempts this ordinance once effective. Not found in this capture.
rules.extraction_notes: Secondary source. Effective date from the table ('effective July 2025'); exact day not stated.
